name: merge-desk
description: AI merges that wait for proof: conflict resolutions land only when both sides' intent survives and CI passes.

paragraphs: Merge Desk shows a merge conflict as two intentions side by side ("ours renames fetchUser", "theirs adds a retry on 429"), asks Gemini to propose a resolution, and runs visible checks before anything lands. The result must parse, pass a deterministic check against the user's chosen option, and pass the selected test suite in a sandbox. A proposal that loses a required change or fails a check is held, with the reason shown. These checks report specific evidence; they do not prove semantic correctness.

requirements.text: Live mode there is sign-in only, for the allowlisted account on this repository; /api/health reports the GitHub App, Gemini, the sandbox credential and the daily usage throttle as configured, and a probe checks it every 30 minutes.
No sign-in and no keys: the desk replays real work recorded on the three seeded demo pull requests (#1 verified, #2 held, #6 a chosen drop) at its original pace.
